findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sdl_get_chainlink_ecosystem · Private data: sdl_get_priority_pool_wallet, sdl_get_resdl_positions, sdl_get_positions, sdl_get_defi_morpho, sdl_get_defi_beefy, sdl_get_portfolio, sdl_build_morpho_deposit, sdl_build_morpho_withdraw, sdl_build_curve_gauge_deposit · Public sink: sdl_get_priority_pool_wallet, sdl_get_chainlink_staking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sdl_get_chainlink_ecosystem · Private data: sdl_get_priority_pool_wallet, sdl_get_resdl_positions, sdl_get_positions, sdl_get_defi_morpho, sdl_get_defi_beefy, sdl_get_portfolio, sdl_build_morpho_deposit, sdl_build_morpho_withdraw, sdl_build_curve_gauge_deposit · Public sink: sdl_get_priority_pool_wallet, sdl_get_chainlink_staking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
